svg.title: 删掉上方负段，也会被迫删掉下方正段
svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"删掉上方负段，也会被迫删掉下方正段","steps":[{"caption":"原网格总分零；U 在上、V 在下，右上正号 P 可以独立保留。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":0,"deletedSegments":[],"score":0,"cutCapacity":null}},{"caption":"选择 U：左右传播会覆盖整个连续负段，不能只删其中一格。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":1,"deletedSegments":[],"score":0,"cutCapacity":null}},{"caption":"U 向下触及 V，V 也必须删除；橙色是传播到的待删区域。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":2,"deletedSegments":[],"score":0,"cutCapacity":null}},{"caption":"整次操作完成，U、V 都变障碍，右上 P 留下，得到一分。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":3,"deletedSegments":["U","V"],"score":1,"cutCapacity":2}},{"caption":"网络里同时选择 U、V，仅切 V→T 的容量二；不是只删 U 的非法选择。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":4,"deletedSegments":["U","V"],"score":1,"cutCapacity":2}}]}

g.text: 删掉上方负段，也会被迫删掉下方正段
若删除完成：权值和 −1，原总分 0，保留分数 1。
